Cobalt Ops (cobaltbay): Hey, since ~09:10 UTC this morning our embeddings p99 is spiking to ~6s for a subset of requests, our app times out. Not consistent across all calls, seems bursty every ~10m. We saw this yesterday too. Any fast mitigations?
Maria (Support): sorry about that — we're looking. Can you confirm if this is the batch job or live traffic? Any recent key changes? :eyes:
Cobalt Ops (cobaltbay): 100% from our nightly batch + some live preview requests mixed in. No key rotation. Payload sizes are unchanged, same model.
Nina (Customer Success): tagging SRE to triage. customer reports p99 jump to ~6s, p95 ~600ms. Customer is worried about production timeouts.
Jake (SRE): I'm on it. Can you repro with a request id or sample request? Also which region?
Cobalt Ops (cobaltbay): region: us-west-2. sample request id: req_2026-03-15_091233 (we'll DM full payload).
Jake (SRE): grabbing traces. initial check: seeing high queue length on embedding worker pool for tenant=cobaltbay, tail latency correlates with queueing. Putting quick log extract below:
```
[09:10:15] enqueue tenant=cobaltbay queue_len=48 worker_idle=2
[09:10:16] schedule shard=embed-2 reason=batch window_ms=30
[09:10:18] start req=req_2026-03-15_091233 queue_wait=4200ms exec_ms=12
[09:10:19] end req=req_2026-03-15_091233 total_ms=4212
throttle_reason=tenant_over_subscription noisy_signature=high_concurrent_embeddings
```
Jake (SRE): looks like a noisy-tenant case — lots of concurrent embed requests from the batch job causing queueing and p99 spikes.
Alex (Platform): I see tenant-level rate limiting triggering fallback throttles in the scheduler. We have a short-term knob: per-tenant reservation (burst tokens) or add to the "quiet-window" reservation list if they need scheduled bursts.
Maria (Support): Cobalt is asking for a bespoke allow/reservation for their nightly batch window (09:00-09:30 UTC) while they tune. Can we do a temporary reservation?
Alex (Platform): Yes — ops can apply a 2-hour reservation to smooth the burst (effectively reserve 20% of one embedding pool to the tenant for the window). This requires a config push and a brief rolling update. I'll prepare.
deploy-bot: config-change queued: per_tenant_reservation apply -> tenant=cobaltbay reserve_pct=20 window=09:00-11:00 UTC
Jake (SRE): before we flip: we should also suggest reducing concurrency in their batch (parallelism -> 8) and enable local prefix cache for repeated prefixes to reduce token count. That will reduce load without infra changes.
Cobalt Ops (cobaltbay): we can reduce concurrency but the batch runtime will go up. We'd prefer infra reservation while we test lower concurrency.
Alex (Platform): understood. Maria, do you have customer agreement to perform the temporary reservation?
Maria (Support): confirmed via DM, they approved a 2-hour reservation. Applying now.
deploy-bot: config-change started: rolling update 3 nodes affected
Jake (SRE): monitoring p99 and queue. Initial target: reduce queue_len below 10 for tenant.
[09:18:00] monitoring: tenant=cobaltbay queue_len=9 p99=480ms p95=210ms
Jake (SRE): patch looks effective so far — p99 dropped from ~6s to ~480ms after reservation took effect. Still watching for secondary noisy tenants.
Nina (Customer Success): passing update to the customer: "we've applied a temporary reservation and are recommending concurrency reduction; please monitor and share any regressions."
Cobalt Ops (cobaltbay): thanks, we see response times drop in our dashboards. Can we convert this to a scheduled recurring reservation for nightly batches while we tune?
Alex (Platform): we can schedule a recurring reservation but operationally that moves them into "reserved capacity" billing category unless it's marked as temporary. I'll ask billing+product for options.
Maria (Support): next steps: 1) keep reservation active for 2 hours, 2) SRE to provide knob suggestions (concurrency, caching), 3) CS to coordinate if customer wants recurring schedule or a migration to Dedicated.
Jake (SRE): also adding mitigation checklist for future: - detect high concurrent embed bursts by tenant, - auto-suggest per-tenant reservation prompt to CS, - add clearer telemetry tag on noisy_signature to trigger automated smoothing.
Cobalt Ops (cobaltbay): appreciated, will try lowering concurrency now and report. Thanks all. :handshake:
Maria (Support): closing loop here once the 2-hour window finishes — will re-open thread if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
